messages:
alex: quick q — noticed routing safelist and runtime config disagreeing after a flag TTL expiry. saw ~10m of traffic routed to old model variant until reconciliation kicked in. anyone else seen this?

maria: yeah saw that in the traces this morning. console shows flag removed at 08:12 but runtime still had the old key until 08:21.

ben: rough timeline? might be a cache TTL vs delete ordering problem.

alex: console delete at 1743217200, runtime reconcile job ran at 1743217860, but edge cache had 604800s default for some keys — oops.

tia: omg default cache 7d is still around? I thought we switched to 5m for volatile flags.

ben: apparently not for safelisted routing entries. the code path uses `Cache::persistent()` for routing entries.

maria: proposal: split routing safelist into two stores — short-lived routing tokens and persistent audit records. that way routing honors shorter TTLs and audit stays.

alex: +1. also need a reconciliation contract: console DELETE should push tombstone as well as invalidate cache. current DELETE only updates DB and emits event, but our edge invalidation is best-effort.

ben: small sketch of a reconciliation API we could add:
```json
POST /internal/flags/reconcile
{
  "flag_key": "route:safelisted-model-42",
  "expected_state": "deleted",
  "force_invalidate": true
}
```

ben: this endpoint would let ops/job run targeted invalidations and report back telemetry.

tia: +1 but need auth and rate limits. also dashboard UX: show last reconciliation attempt and TTLs in the flag detail. devs keep asking "is this live?"

maria: telemetry asks: emit events `flag.reconcile.start` and `flag.reconcile.finish` with counts of invalidations and failures. then add an alert if >1% failures per hour.

alex: also edge-case: dual-write windows. if console delete races with a rollout that adds a new variant, we could end up with the wrong variant in runtime. need versioned tombstones (e.g., tombstone_v = 3).

ben: agree. we already have `version` on flags. tombstone should increment version and reconciler should enforce version monotonicity.

tia: regarding UX: in the rollouts tab add a small badge: "reconciled: 08:21 (9m after change)" and a link to last reconcile run logs. that'll reduce noisy pings.

maria: who owns the reconciler? ops or platform? Ops wants visibility, platform wants to ship the job.

alex: Platform should implement it, Ops will run it (managed job) and Console will call the API. we ship API + dashboard hooks.

deploy-bot: canary reconciler job scheduled to run at 1743220800 on staging (image: reconciler:v0.3-canary) :rocket:

ben: can we add a quick query to find stale routing entries?
```
SELECT key, last_seen, ttl FROM routing_entries WHERE last_seen < now() - (ttl || ' seconds')::interval;
```

alex: thanks — I'll add reconciliation metrics and a console UX PR. tagging @tia for the dashboard bits.

tia: on it, will mock the badge and add a tiny explainer tooltip about eventual invalidation windows. :thumbsup:

maria: leaving note: run a one-off job to re-evaluate safelist entries in prod after deploy. might fix currently stale entries.

alex: cool — creating runbook entry for this + add an alert if reconcile lag > 2m for routing flags.

ben::+1:

tia::sparkles:
